title: NZ MBIE Determination 2026/014 (comparative): proposed refusal over bracing compliance pathway (B1/AS1)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Rotorua Lakes Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; B1/AS1 first edition, amendment 21 (effective 2 November 2023 until 31 July 2026) as cited
source_url_note: Building CodeHub resource page for the same MBIE determination (Information provider: MBIE); the building.govt.nz determination page is WAF-blocked for this worker.

facts.text: The authority's proposed decision to refuse a building consent for a new dwelling related to the compliance pathway for the bracing design.
Building consent BC24-011449 for a horseshoe-shaped single-level dwelling around a central courtyard was lodged in 2024.
The applicant designed the bracing using NZS 3604 and NZS 4229 to derive bracing demands and resistance.
Acceptable Solution B1/AS1 is cited as first edition, amendment 21.
The determination notes that using the Verification Method alongside the Acceptable Solution is common practice.

limitations: Comparative test only: New Zealand Building Act 2004 and Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992). No Alberta applicability asserted; no NBC(AE) mapping.

Applicant application documents are not published; drawings and photos appear only as figures inside the determination. Figures were located by caption, not visually inspected.
Structural calculations and bracing schedules are not in the file; they are summarised in the determination.
